questions.question: What new thing does God promise in Jeremiah 31?
options: A new and glorious temple far greater than Solomon's
A new covenant, with his law written on their hearts
A new king who would sit upon the throne of David
A new and spacious land far beyond the great river
questions.answer: A new covenant, with his law written on their hearts

questions.question: What does God say he will do with their sin under the new covenant?
options: Hide away his face from them entirely until they repent
Punish it on to the third and even the fourth generation
Forgive their iniquity and remember their sin no more
Demand from them a very great sacrifice in order to cover it
questions.answer: Forgive their iniquity and remember their sin no more

questions.question: Jeremiah 31 pictures Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted.
I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their _____.
I have loved you with an everlasting _____; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
